snippet.title: Bootstrap Island - Major Update 2: Overlord Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Survivors, prepare yourselves for a brand-new challenge in Bootstrap Island! Major Update 2 introduces the fearsome Jungle Overlord—a towering and cunning beast hidden deep within the island's interior. The Overlord knows his territory well, using the jungle to his advantage. To survive this encounter, make sure your gear is prepared, as only the well-equipped will stand a chance in his Dark Lair.

KEY UPDATE FEATURES
🦍 Jungle Overlord – Face the island’s terrifying ape ruler
🌑 Dark Lair – A new area where only the strongest survive
🍲 Spoiling Food – Perishables must be cooked to stay edible
🌋 Day Counter – Track your survival days atop the Volcano
👟 Boots – Boost your speed by unlocking and equipping new gear

The first boss is a massive, agile, and cunning beast. Survivors who have already mastered the basics will find an entirely new challenge! Gear up, strategize, and dive into the latest chapter of Bootstrap Island!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1942110/Bootstrap_Island/
Discord: https://discord.gg/q8m3CRVVmJ

Music: Independent, bespoke music from AM Usualsuspects and Synchadvisor
